nectar.unit: micrograms sugar per flower per day
nectar.aggregation: primary mean raw sugar within each reported source and then equal source mean (unknown source is one distinct stratum); log10(1+sugar / 1 microgram per flower per day). Repeated values retained, no assumed independent records. Pooled row mean matches paper's stated averaging rule; median and known-source sensitivities. Strict-positive requires all recorded values positive; detected means at least one positive measurement, not obligate reward status.
